title: WynnX
body:
# What is WynnX?
  
  A modpack focused on giving you the best experience on Wynncraft. As you would expect from Minecraft's biggest MMORPG the mods we use are constantly changing and we will do our best to keep everything up to date.

<details>
<summary>Performance</summary>

**[Cubes Without Borders](https://modrinth.com/mod/cubes-without-borders):** Adds a true borderless fullscreen window mode to the video settings menu. It allows you to seamlessly move your mouse to a second monitor or open other applications on top of Minecraft without the game minimizing

**[Entity Culling](https://modrinth.com/mod/entityculling):** Skips rendering blocks and entities when they are hidden behind walls or outside your field of view.

**[Ferrite Core](https://modrinth.com/mod/ferrite-core):** Drastically reduces Minecraft's RAM usage by streamlining how block states and properties are stored in memory

**[Immediately Fast](https://modrinth.com/mod/immediatelyfast):** An optimization mod that speeds up the rendering of 2D/3D screen elements like menus, text, the HUD, particles, and map items.

**[Iris Shaders](https://modrinth.com/mod/iris):** Enables custom graphics packages to completely overhaul Minecraft's visuals. It allows the game to render realistic lighting, dynamic shadows, lifelike water reflections

**[KEFCLS](https://modrinth.com/mod/forcecloseworldloadingscreen):** Bypasses the artificial waiting time on the world-joining screen, letting you jump into gameplay the millisecond a chunk is received

**[Lithium](https://modrinth.com/mod/lithium):** Improves game physics, mob AI, chunk loading, and world generation speed. It optimizes the game's internal logic and math calculations to significantly reduce CPU load and server lag

**[ModernFix](https://modrinth.com/mod/modernfix):** Fixes memory leaks, speeds up game launching, and fixes various engine bugs. It modernizes the game's underlying systems to reduce RAM spikes, improve stability, and cut down loading times

**[Particle Core](https://modrinth.com/mod/particle-core):** Revamps how game particles are processed and loaded

**[Sodium](https://modrinth.com/mod/sodium):** A complete replacement for Minecraft's rendering engine that drastically improves frame rates, eliminates micro-stutters, and fixes graphical glitches

**[Sodium Extra](https://modrinth.com/mod/sodium-extra):** An essential addon that expands the video settings menu with advanced toggles for animations, particles, and fine details
</details>
<details>
<summary>Quality of Life</summary>

**[Shoulder Surfing Reloaded](https://modrinth.com/mod/shoulder-surfing-reloaded):** Transforms the rigid, center-locked third-person camera into an over-the-shoulder perspective

**[Wynn Spell Caster](https://modrinth.com/mod/wynncraft-spell-caster):** A combat utility mod that maps single-click keyboard hotkeys to cast specific magic spells

**[Wynntils](https://modrinth.com/mod/wynntils):** A massive gameplay enhancement mod designed specifically for the Wynncraft MMO server. It overhauls the default user interface by adding a fully interactive fullscreen world map, custom quest trackers, on-screen waypoint navigation, and clean stat overlays to streamline your RPG adventure

**[WynnExtras](https://modrinth.com/mod/wynnextras):** Adds a custom bank overlay with cross-character item searching, a streamlined class selection menu, automated skillpoint calculators, and integrated raid tracking tools to simplify end-game progression

**[Wynnventory](https://modrinth.com/mod/wynnventory):** Integrates automated item sorting, historical trade market price tooltips, and a specialized in-game screen to instantly check global raid, lootrun, and active aspect reward tables from anywhere in the world without tabbing out of the game
</details>

**WARNING: If a mod is removed for game breaking reasons you may need to re-download the modpack**
